title: Tomato recipe
desc: A simple recipe for a delicious tomato dish.
steps: Cut the tomatoes in half and place them on a baking sheet.
Drizzle olive oil over the tomatoes and sprinkle with minced garlic, salt, and pepper.
Roast the tomatoes in the oven for 20-25 minutes until they are tender and slightly caramelized.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped basil before serving.
